items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: But it's always going to be Willie the Mouse and stuff, by the way. Oh, boy, I wish that man prayed that letter.

ctx.x: I'm not trying to say anything about saying he's a Jewish religion.

I never read an opinion so biased in my life, you know, because of... Now, you see, but it's one thing, though. You know what you're going to find. You're always going to find that it's mediocre talent that talks that way. You see, if they'd have asked Duke Ellington about jelly, if he wouldn't have gave him no great ovation, he still wouldn't have brought him down the drain. Duke would have said, well, yeah, it sounds like great music for its time, or something like that. You know what I mean? Now, here's one of…
I want to hear a bad man about it. I want to see if you're going to talk about Aaron Harris. Yeah. Yeah. Well, it's not one of you. It's not on this. Yeah. It's Aaron.
